scope: Public-facing instructions and AI-to-versioned-engine reproducibility across A7-bound specialist products, not domain engineering approvals
principle: Humans speak their goals and choose outcomes. The AI resolves intent and evidence. Versioned deterministic software computes and validates. The product presents understandable, progressive, source-linked results, with limits and authority explicit.
publication_rule: The canonical standard is here in A7; each owning product publishes a domain-specific derived human guide; do not duplicate domain facts in A7.

execution_sequence.title: Tell us what you need
execution_sequence.action: Free-form language, optional existing files/data and corrections; avoid forcing JSON forms

execution_sequence.title: Interpret with evidence
execution_sequence.action: Locate provider-native source, classify authority, link quoted values, ask only missing independent facts

execution_sequence.title: Validate a typed request
execution_sequence.action: Normalize units, coordinates, IDs, revisions, source hashes, prerequisites, constraints and permissions; reject unsupported claims

execution_sequence.title: Run the owning engine
execution_sequence.action: Run version-pinned deterministic algorithms; public CI for synthetic data, private authenticated runner for restricted sources

execution_sequence.title: Check and capture evidence
execution_sequence.action: Regression tests, invariants, provenance, checksums, error disclosure, and separate human licensed/professional approval when required

execution_sequence.title: Show useful, layered results
execution_sequence.action: Start with 3D or most useful domain-specific view; provide role-specific filtering, drawings, labels, drill-down, accessibly

execution_sequence.title: Preserve reproducibility
execution_sequence.action: Persist source version, canonical input fingerprint, engine SHA, runtime/dependency pins, output manifest and release status

reproducibility.guaranteed_only_for: Same normalized input bytes, pinned software/toolchain/assets, fixed deterministic settings and controlled external source revisions; evidence checked
reproducibility.not_guaranteed: Identical results from identical unconstrained prompts across different AI models or changed external providers

progressive_detail.role_boundary: Workers must not mistake synthetic, estimated, candidate or unapproved drawings for issued-for-construction instructions

dimensions.2D: Source-linked drawings, plans, elevations, sections and details
dimensions.3D: Navigable geometry with semantic selection and layers; default for CAD where supported
dimensions.4D: Model components linked to verified milestones, schedule tasks and dependencies
dimensions.5D: Verified quantities linked to separate authoritative rates/cost data, never a guess from imagery

authority.high_stakes: Engineer/client/regulator approval external to language interpretation

adoption.do_not_create: Separate competing governance templates for each repository
